FATIMA COSTALES fatimacostaIes18@gmaiI.com Dear Ma'am Costales: This has reference to your electronic mail dated 29 July 2024 requesting the Department's opinion on: Whether a person who has been abroad for 6 years, did not vote during the last Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (BSKE2023) and a sibling to a former SK with a pending budget case, can be appointed as Barangay Treasurer? 1 Under Section 395 of the Local Govemment Code, the Barangay Treasurer shall be appointed by the Punong Barangay with the concurrence of the majority of all the Sangguniang Barangay Members. The appointment of the barangay treasurer shall not be subject to attestation by the Civil Service Commission. A barangay treasurer shall be of legal age, a qualified voter and actual resident of the barangay concerned. The Local Government Code prohibits the appointment of a person as barangay treasurer if he is a member of the Sangguniang Barangay, a government employee or a relative of the punong barangay within the fourth civil degree of consanguinity or affinity. Our own interpretation of one qualification mentioned is that a registered voter is different from a qualified voter. A registered voter is a voter duly registered as provided under Republic Act No. 81892 with the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) that he/she is eligible to vote for the elections while a qualified voter is a person possess all the qualifications to be a registered voter but did not undergo the process of registration before the COMELEC in order to be eligible to vote for the elections. Moreover, under Sec. 9 of Republic Act No. 8189, Any person who temporarily resides in another city, municipality or country solely by reason of his occupation, profession, 1 Email Letter dated 29 July 2024 by Fatima Costales 2 The Voter's Registration Act of 1996; AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A GENERAL REGISTRATION OF VOTERS, ADOPTING A SYSTEM OF CONTINUING REGISTRATION, PRESCRIBING THE PROCEDURES THEREOF AND AUTHORIZING THE APPROPRIATION OF FUNDS THEREFOR. "Matino, Mahusay, at Maaasahan" Tel. (02) 8876-3454

employment in private or public service, educational activities, work in the military or naval reservations within the Philippines, service in the Armed Forces of the Philippines, the National Police Forces, or confinement or detention in government institutions in accordance with law, shall not be deemed to have lost his original residence. Hence, the fact that the person sought to be appointed was not able to vote during the recent BSKE is immaterial to his/her appointment. In the case at hand, if the person to bo appointed possesses all the qualifications mentioned above as provided by the Local Government Code of 1991 and none of the disqualification, he/she is qualified to bo appointed as Barangay Treasurer. The pending case of his/her sibling who is a former SK will not affect his/her appointment as Barangay Tæasurer because such case is personal to his/her sibling unless the person to be appointed as Barangay Treasurer is also indicted to a case. This view is, however, without prejudice to the authoritative decision of the courts of competent jurisdiction. We hope we have enlightened you on the matter.
